status: NON-CANON lab model (kT "Rather go out the side", 2026-11-15)
concept: twin-sphere rover = crew cabin, exits through a starboard side door (option A of rover_trade 2026-11-03, rebuilt for v2)

door.lower: lower flank panel hinged on the belly corner, folds down as a ramp
door.upper: upper flank panel (the wing on B3/B4) hinged on the shoulder, swings up to horizontal as an awning

mass_basis: rover_trade option A (inside, side door + ramp + own gear) is the v1 baseline: no rover-integration delta vs v1; v2 deltas are twin spheres +0.4 t and wings
open: hatch trunk to the dorsal hatch must retract upward before the rover slides out
longerons above and below the 4.2 m side opening (shoulder and belly corner) carry hull bending
door seals through the entry heat shield on the lower flank
wing hinge on the shoulder must also be the door hinge (ground loads)
